name: Crescent Slash
description: A quick celestial blade strike against the nearest foe.

name: Astral Bolt
description: A guided starbolt strikes a nearby enemy.

name: Comet Dash
description: Dash toward your target, striking enemies along the way.

name: Healing Star
description: Restore health with a warm constellation of healing light.

name: Crystal Aegis
description: Become protected by a crystal shield for five seconds.

name: Gravity Well
description: A gravity pulse strikes foes around your nearest target.

name: Meteor Rain
description: Call a shower of stars over surrounding enemies.

name: Luminous Bind
description: Damage and briefly bind the nearest enemy.

name: Celestial Eclipse
description: At 100 Astral energy, unleash an eclipse that strikes every nearby foe.
